Graduate Student Leadership
Award

Issued by University of San Francisco · May 2026

Associated with University of San Francisco

This award is given to a graduate student who has consistently worked and succeeded in enriching and impacting student life and the values of Student Life throughout their career at USF. A student who has contributed to making a positive impact on the campus climate and has demonstrated committed involvement in clubs, organizations, programs, or other areas of campus involvement. This student acts as an inspiration to others, modeling the way for a more just and humane world and is committed to working with and for others.

Dean’s Medal of Excellence

Issued by University of San Francisco School Of Management · Dec 2025

Associated with University of San Francisco

The Dean’s Medal of Excellence in Scholarship is awarded to one candidate of the Masagung Graduate School of Management who exemplifies leadership through professional and academic development, in alignment with USF’s mission and values. To be eligible, nominees must rank in the top 5% of their respective program.
